export_evidence: ImportKey page for ABBOTT HEALTHCARE PRIVATE LIMITED (Unit Nos. 3 4, Corporate Park, Sion-Trombay Road, Chembur) shows only inbound lanes: "2026-02-28 | IMAR SPAIN PACK, S.L. | ABBOTT HEALTHCARE PRIVATE LIMITED | ... | MADRID, SPAIN | SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC INBOM4, India | 85015190 | 7800928". All 4 visible rows are imports into India; no outbound shipment row with an Indian origin port was displayed. Source counter: page header states "Total Shipments 85112 Records detected", "Trading Partners 86", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-28"; rows actually seen = 4 (all import, all dated 2026-02-28, all from IMAR SPAIN PACK, S.L., BOL 7800928). The /export sub-path returned HTTP 404 and the ?type=export variant returned the identical import-only page, so export records could not be isolated.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report India sales split was retrieved. thecompanycheck.com and zaubacorp.com both returned HTTP 403 (blocked), and DuckDuckGo search was unavailable (connection refused) for the whole session, so no domestic-supply record could be read. Not public in what was reachable — recorded as null rather than inferred.
note: IMPORTANT — the declared HS code 330510 (shampoo) is not supported by any record seen. The only HS codes actually observed on this entity's customs rows are 85015190 (electric motor), 84229090 (packaging-machine parts), 40169390 (rubber gaskets) and 84213990 (filters) — i.e. machinery spare parts imported from Spain, not FMCG goods. Per project rule 3 this is NOT grounds for rejection: the company stays in the base and the HS code should be corrected to the factual activity. Note also that the claimed industry 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is inconsistent with the observed trade: Abbott Healthcare Pvt Ltd is an Indian pharma/nutrition manufacturer, and the visible customs traffic is inbound capital spares. Evidence of actual shipments is one-sided: inbound imports are confirmed by dated customs rows with BOL numbers, but no export shipment and no domestic supply record was verified in this session. Export status is therefore 'unknown', not 'confirmed' — the 85,112-record counter is a platform total that could not be broken down by direction on the free view, and the four rows actually seen are all imports. Do not treat the site's 'Import/Export Data' label as proof of exports. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in reachable sources).
